quizzes.title: Schemes and Electoral Options: MCQ Practice
quizzes.passage: The Governance, Schemes and Infrastructure section of the March 2026 round-up covers four domestic initiatives. The first concerns elections. A formal electoral option was introduced to give voters a way to express dissatisfaction with the candidates on offer, while strengthening democratic participation and voter freedom. The Supreme Court has also observed how this option has affected political parties over the past decade. The second item is a rooftop solar programme launched in 2024. It is described as the world's largest domestic rooftop solar initiative, and it aims to reach one crore households. Households that take part receive free electricity up to a set monthly limit, and the programme runs till FY 2026-27. The third item concerns rural water supply, which is covered under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0. The round-up notes that the initiative aims to improve governance, monitoring and service delivery in rural areas. The fourth item is a rapid transit system. The Prime Minister inaugurated India's first Namo Bharat Regional Rapid Transit System, a rail-based service in the National Capital Region. Its implementing agency is a joint venture of the Government of India and several state governments. Each entry in the round-up is set out with its own details, so the items can be read separately.

questions.q: Which ministry launched the Sujal Gaon ID?
options: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the Ministry of Jal Shakti launched the Sujal Gaon ID.

questions.q: What is the nodal ministry of the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
options: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
questions.explanation: The booklet lists the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy as the nodal ministry for this scheme.

questions.q: What is the maximum speed of the Namo Bharat RRTS, in km/h?
questions.explanation: The booklet describes Namo Bharat RRTS as a semi-high speed system running at up to 180 km/h.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): NOTA allows voters to reject all candidates while being barred from taking part in the democratic process.
Reason (R): NOTA was introduced by the Supreme Court in PUCL vs Union of India (2013).
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: A is false because the booklet says NOTA lets voters take part in the democratic process, while R matches the booklet's account of its introduction.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Sujal Gaon ID   ->   D. Rooftop solar scheme with subsidy of up to 40% of installation cost
II. Namo Bharat RRTS   ->   C. Digital identifier for rural piped water schemes
III. NOTA   ->   A. Rail-based semi-high speed commuter system
IV. PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana   ->   B. Option to reject all candidates in an election
questions.explanation: The booklet links the Sujal Gaon ID to rural water schemes, Namo Bharat to rail transit, NOTA to rejecting all candidates and PM Surya Ghar to a 40% subsidy.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Sujal Gaon ID is linked to a Sujalam Bharat ID.
II. Namo Bharat RRTS is designed for inter-city regional travel within the NCR.
III. The PM Surya Ghar scheme has the Ministry of Jal Shakti as its nodal ministry.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the booklet, while III is wrong because the nodal ministry is the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. NOTA was used in the 2013 Assembly Elections in Chhattisgarh, Mizoram, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi.
II. The PM Surya Ghar scheme provides a subsidy of up to 40% of installation cost.
III. Namo Bharat RRTS was implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while III is wrong because NCRTC implements Namo Bharat RRTS.

quizzes.title: Schemes and Electoral Options: Short Answer Practice
quizzes.passage: Four domestic initiatives appear under the governance and infrastructure heading of the March 2026 round-up. One of them gives voters a formal way to reject every candidate standing in an election while still taking part in democratic life. Its stated purpose is to let citizens express dissatisfaction and to strengthen voter freedom. Another initiative is a rooftop solar scheme launched in 2024, which is described as the world's largest domestic rooftop solar initiative. Its objective is to install rooftop systems in one crore households, and participants receive free electricity up to a monthly limit. The scheme's subsidy covers a share of the installation cost, and it runs till FY 2026-27. A third initiative is the Sujal Gaon ID, launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti. It assigns a unique, scheme-based digital identifier to every rural piped drinking water supply scheme, creating a digital record that supports governance and monitoring. Finally, the Namo Bharat system is a rail-based commuter service built for travel within the National Capital Region. It is a semi-high speed system, and its implementing agency is a joint venture of several governments. The round-up gives each entry its own heading and short summary. Each entry is short, and the items are listed one after another within the section.

questions.q: Which Supreme Court case introduced NOTA in India? (case name with year)
questions.explanation: The booklet says NOTA was introduced by the Supreme Court in PUCL vs Union of India (2013).

questions.q: What is the maximum speed of the Namo Bharat RRTS, in km/h? (number)
questions.explanation: The booklet gives the speed of Namo Bharat RRTS as up to 180 km/h.

questions.q: Which ministry is the nodal ministry for the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana? (abbreviation)
accept: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
questions.explanation: The booklet names the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) as the nodal ministry.

questions.q: Each Sujal Gaon ID is linked to which other ID? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that each Sujal Gaon ID is linked to a Sujalam Bharat ID.

questions.q: Up to what percentage of the installation cost is the rooftop solar subsidy? (number, in %)
questions.explanation: The booklet gives the financial support as a subsidy of up to 40% of the installation cost.

questions.q: Which corporation implements the Namo Bharat RRTS? (abbreviation)
questions.explanation: The booklet names the National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) as the implementing agency.

questions.q: How many units of free electricity per month does the rooftop solar scheme provide? (number of units)
questions.explanation: The booklet says the scheme provides free electricity up to 300 units per month.

quizzes.title: Trade and Energy Items: MCQ Practice
quizzes.passage: The Trade and Energy Diplomacy part of the March 2026 round-up covers four items. The first is a trade principle used among members of the WTO, and the round-up explains how it applies to trade concessions. The second is an agreement between India and the European Union, which concerns trade in services. The third is a major new oil refinery project in the United States, which the round-up describes as a large undertaking valued in the hundreds of billions. The fourth is a type of crude oil called light shale oil, which the round-up says is produced in several countries. Each item is described in its own short entry, and the round-up gives details for each one. The refinery entry names a company as a key partner and identifies the company that developed the project. Light shale oil is described in terms of its physical features and the kind of rock formations in which it is trapped. The round-up treats these items separately, so each entry can be read on its own. The round-up gives the refinery's location within Texas and points to a port in the south of the state as part of the project. For light shale oil, the entry also lists the countries where it is produced, which allows readers to see its global spread.

questions.q: Which Indian company was announced as a key partner in the $300 billion Texas Oil Refinery Project?
questions.explanation: The booklet states that Reliance Industries Limited was announced as a key partner in the Texas refinery project.

questions.q: Which company developed the Texas refinery project?
questions.explanation: The booklet names America First Refining as the developer of the Texas refinery.

questions.q: What is the sulphur content of light shale oil, as described in the booklet?
questions.explanation: The booklet describes light shale oil as having a low sulphur content.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Light shale oil has a high hydrogen-to-carbon ratio.
Reason (R): Light shale oil is found mainly in deep offshore fields.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: A is true because the booklet mentions a high hydrogen-to-carbon ratio, while R is false since the booklet describes light shale oil as trapped in shale or tight sandstone.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Light shale oil   ->   D. Company announced as key partner in the Texas refinery project
II. Most Favoured Nation   ->   A. Low-density crude trapped in low-permeability shale or tight sandstone
III. Permian Basin   ->   B. Equal treatment of all WTO members in trade concessions
IV. Reliance Industries Limited   ->   C. Largest oil-producing region in the USA
questions.explanation: The booklet pairs light shale oil with its crude description, MFN with equal treatment, the Permian Basin with the largest oil-producing region and Reliance with the key partner role.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. Light shale oil is also known as light tight oil.
II. India and the EU agreed to grant MFN status in trade in services for 5 years.
III. The Texas refinery is located at the Port of Brownsville in North Texas.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the booklet, while III is wrong because the refinery is located in South Texas.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. MFN ensures non-discriminatory global trade.
II. The Texas refinery is located in the Permian Basin.
III. Reliance Industries Limited developed the Texas refinery.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while III is wrong because America First Refining developed the refinery.

quizzes.title: Trade and Energy Items: Short Answer Practice
quizzes.passage: The March 2026 round-up's trade and energy entries cover several related topics. One concerns a principle that governs trade among WTO members, which the round-up describes in some detail. A second concerns an agreement between India and the European Union on trade in services. A third concerns a refinery project in the United States that has been described as a large investment. The fourth entry is about a crude oil that is produced in several countries and has a high hydrogen-to-carbon ratio. The crude is described as low-density and is trapped within low-permeability shale or tight sandstone formations. The refinery is described as a major new oil refinery constructed in the USA, and the refinery entry names a major Indian firm as a partner. The round-up also lists where the crude oil is produced, which allows readers to see its global reach. Each of these topics is written as a separate entry, and each entry has a title and a short paragraph of text. The round-up presents the services agreement as a separate item from the refinery and the crude oil entry. Readers can compare these entries with the other items in the same section of the update. The round-up gives this section its own heading.

questions.q: Which Indian company was announced as a key partner in the $300 billion Texas Oil Refinery Project? (company name)
questions.explanation: The booklet names Reliance Industries Limited as the key partner announced for the Texas refinery project.

questions.q: Which company developed the Texas refinery project? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the refinery was developed by America First Refining.

questions.q: Which trade principle requires a country to treat all WTO members equally in trade concessions? (name or abbreviation)
questions.explanation: The booklet defines Most Favoured Nation (MFN) as the rule requiring equal treatment of all WTO members in trade concessions.

questions.q: For how many years did India and the EU agree to grant MFN status in trade in services? (number of years)
questions.explanation: The booklet says India and the EU agreed to grant MFN status in trade in services for 5 years.

questions.q: What is light shale oil also called? (two words)
questions.explanation: The booklet gives the alternative name of light shale oil as Light Tight Oil.

questions.q: Which region of the USA is described as its largest oil-producing region? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the Permian Basin as the largest oil-producing region in the USA.

questions.q: At which port in South Texas is the refinery located? (name of port)
questions.explanation: The booklet places the refinery at the Port of Brownsville in South Texas.

quizzes.title: Sports and Border Trade: MCQ Practice
quizzes.passage: The Sports and Places in News section of the March 2026 round-up has two entries. The first concerns a sports event for tribal communities, which is scheduled to take place in 2026. The event is designed to bring tribal sporting talent into the national sports ecosystem while preserving traditional indigenous games. It is held under a national sports scheme, which aims to strengthen India's sports ecosystem, and a mascot has been chosen to represent the pride, bravery and cultural identity of tribal communities. The round-up lists the sports involved and the bodies that organise the event. The second entry concerns a Himalayan border pass. The round-up describes it as the first Indian border post for trade with China, and the pass lies in a region of Uttarakhand. The round-up says India is set to resume border trade with China through this pass. An alternate route through Nathu La Pass is mentioned, while a route through Dharchula is under repair. The sports entry and the border entry are both presented as current news from March 2026, and each has its own short paragraph and key points. The round-up introduces both entries with short headings in the same format as other items.

questions.q: Which two sports are included in the Khelo India Tribal Games?
questions.explanation: The booklet lists Mallakhamb and Kabaddi as the sports included in the Tribal Games.

questions.q: After a COVID-induced suspension of how many years is India set to resume border trade via Lipulekh Pass?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the resumption follows a six-year COVID-induced suspension of trade through the pass.

questions.q: Lipulekh Pass is situated in which region of Uttarakhand?
questions.explanation: The booklet places Lipulekh Pass in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Lipulekh Pass is set to reopen for border trade with Nepal.
Reason (R): Lipulekh Pass is a key route for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: A is false because the booklet says the reopening concerns border trade with China, while R is a correct statement from the booklet.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Khelo India Scheme   ->   C. Tri-junction of India, Nepal and China
II. Morveer   ->   D. Host state of the first Khelo India Tribal Games
III. Lipulekh Pass   ->   A. Launched in 2016-17 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
IV. Chhattisgarh   ->   B. Mascot of the Tribal Games
questions.explanation: The booklet pairs the scheme with its 2016-17 launch, the mascot Morveer with the Tribal Games, the pass with its tri-junction and Chhattisgarh with hosting the Games.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Khelo India Scheme was launched in 2016-17 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
II. The Sports Authority of India is among the organising bodies of the Tribal Games.
III. Morveer is the mascot representing the cultural identity of the Lipulekh Pass region.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II match the booklet, while III is wrong because Morveer represents the cultural identity of tribal communities.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. Chhattisgarh is set to host the first Khelo India Tribal Games.
II. Morveer is the mascot of the Khelo India Scheme.
III. Kabaddi is one of the sports included in the Tribal Games.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II is wrong because Morveer is the mascot of the Tribal Games.

quizzes.title: Sports and Border Trade: Short Answer Practice
quizzes.passage: The sports entry in the March 2026 round-up concerns a first-ever event for tribal communities. The event is planned for 2026 under a national sports scheme whose purpose is to strengthen India's sports ecosystem. It aims to bring tribal sporting talent into the national system while keeping traditional indigenous games alive. The round-up lists the sports involved and notes that several national bodies share responsibility for organising the event. A mascot has been chosen to represent the pride, bravery and cultural identity of tribal communities. The second entry concerns a Himalayan pass in the Uttarakhand region. The round-up describes it as the first Indian border post for trade with a neighbouring country. Trade through the pass was paused during a pandemic and is set to resume. The pass is also used on a yatra route, and an alternate route through Nathu La Pass is mentioned, while a route through Dharchula is under repair. Both entries appear in the same section, which is titled Sports and Places in News. The round-up presents both items as news from March 2026, and each has its own short paragraph and key points. Readers are given the names of the bodies and the purpose of each initiative in the entries.

questions.q: What is the name of the mascot of the Khelo India Tribal Games? (name)
questions.explanation: The booklet names Morveer as the mascot of the Tribal Games.

questions.q: In which year was the Khelo India Scheme launched? (academic year, e.g. 2016-17)
questions.explanation: The booklet states that the Khelo India Scheme was launched in 2016-17.

questions.q: Which ministry launched the Khelo India Scheme? (abbreviation)
accept: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
questions.explanation: The booklet names the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports as the launching ministry.

questions.q: In which Indian state is the first Khelo India Tribal Games set to be hosted in 2026? (state name)
questions.explanation: The booklet says Chhattisgarh is set to host the first-ever Khelo India Tribal Games in 2026.

questions.q: In which region of Uttarakhand is Lipulekh Pass located? (region name)
questions.explanation: The booklet places Lipulekh Pass in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand.

questions.q: After how many years of COVID-induced suspension is India set to resume border trade via Lipulekh Pass? (number of years)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the resumption as following a 6-year COVID-induced suspension.

questions.q: Lipulekh Pass is a tri-junction of India, Nepal and which third country? (country name)
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the pass as a tri-junction of India, Nepal and China (Tibet region).
